stories.title: FlashML-org/FreeVideo
stories.reason: Running code, not a description: FreeVideo serves MiniMax H3 video generation in 8GB VRAM/16GB RAM with hardware-adaptive execution — directly matches the 'how models are served' and 'repo beats paper' weighting.
key_facts: Runs MiniMax H3 (OpenVDN VDN-H3, hybrid attention) in as little as 8GB VRAM / 16GB RAM
Apache-2.0 code; weights under MiniMax's own community license with territorial restrictions
ComfyUI plugin plus a one-click Windows launcher and Linux CLI
447 GitHub stars
